title: Growth & Performance Marketing
subtitle: Measure what matters, convert more of it and scale the channels that pay back
description:
Growth is a system: reliable measurement, a site that converts, and channels you can scale because you know what they return. This path starts with the marketing fundamentals and GA4, then shows how to measure in a privacy-first world with consent mode, server-side tagging and modelled conversions. You learn conversion rate optimisation, paid social, AI-assisted performance marketing and lifecycle email, then apply it all to e-commerce growth, influencer programmes and affiliate and discount-code partnerships.

The emphasis throughout is on decisions you can defend: clear hypotheses, clean data, honest attribution and budgets that follow evidence. Every course is free, practical and ends with a certificate for your LinkedIn profile.
outcomes: Set up trustworthy measurement in GA4 with consent-aware tracking
Run conversion experiments with clear hypotheses and honest results
Plan, launch and optimise paid social campaigns with AI assistance
Build lifecycle email flows that grow repeat revenue
Scale e-commerce, influencer and affiliate channels on measured return
audience: Agency teams managing client ad budgets
